landing.title: Verity
landing.tagline: Every claims decision, grounded in evidence you can defend.
landing.persona: Built for Dana Whitfield's team — Fenwick Mutual's Senior Claims Research Analysts and SIU/Compliance officers, who need a citable precedent brief in hours, not days, before an appeal or a Department of Insurance audit.
landing.feature1.title: Precedent Briefs, not guesses
landing.feature1.body: Every answer cites its source with a [n] marker. A dedicated ghost-citation check flags any citation that wasn't actually retrieved.
landing.feature2.title: Fraud-signal highlighting
landing.feature2.body: Possible fraud-pattern signals are surfaced inline — always a signal for SIU review, never a determination.
landing.feature3.title: Catastrophe events, tracked
landing.feature3.body: Pin a CAT event and every related research report rolls up underneath it automatically.
landing.feature4.title: A tamper-evident audit trail
landing.feature4.body: Every AI call is hash-chained — an admin can verify the log hasn't been altered after the fact.
landing.disclaimer: Fenwick Mutual is a fictional company created for this project. Verity is a demo — not legal or compliance advice. All regulatory and case-law content shown is fictional and for illustrative purposes only.
